name: KINS 5533
title: Current Research and Issues in Athletic Training
description: Acquaints students of athletic training with the recent research in the field, the components of conducting and publishing research in this field, and preparation for research endeavors at the graduate level. Covers relevant issues, policies, and laws related to athletic training that are currently being regionally or nationally debated, discussed, and/or implemented.
requirement_description: No requirements to take this course.
